# OpenAI / ChatGPT + Codex changelog — captured 2026-08-10
# https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/changelog
# (sources.json still points at developers.openai.com/codex/changelog, a 308 cross-host redirect)

Newest entry is still **Codex CLI 0.147.0, August 7, 2026** — IDENTICAL to the 2026-08-07 and
2026-08-09 captures. No entries dated August 8, 9 or 10.

0.147.0 (Aug 7, reported 2026-08-07): portable Agent Plugins with search across local, personal,
workspace and remote plugin catalogs; conversation sections and incremental transcript browsing;
`--approve-for-me` automatic approvals; import Cursor-managed skills and sync Claude/Cursor
conversations; MCP protocol 2026-07-28 (paginated discovery, multi-round requests, non-blocking
server startup); cached web search; remote conversation compaction for Amazon Bedrock. Fixes include
secret redaction in commands/history and plugin isolation hardening.
0.146.1 (Aug 5, reported 2026-08-07): safer automatic-review defaults for cyber-capable models.

SDK releases — unchanged, no releases between Aug 4 and Aug 10:
  openai-python v2.53.0 (Aug 3) "GPT-5.5 model support" + tool name/namespace fields on Response
  types; v2.52.1 (Aug 3) CI pin; v2.52.0 (Jul 31) content provenance checks, Retry-After handling,
  mTLS docs.
  openai-node v7.4.0 (Aug 3) same model/tool-metadata adds + mTLS transport examples; v7.3.0
  (Jul 31) content provenance checks; v7.2.0 (Jul 30) fast tier.
  NOTE (carried): SDK release-note wording mislabels model families — 5.6 shipped Jul 9 but the
  Aug 3 SDK entry says "GPT-5.5". Corroborate model launches against openai.com/index/*.

Status RSS (status.openai.com/history.rss): newest incidents still **Aug 5, 2026** — elevated errors
with image generation (Files, Image Generation), issues with Custom GPT actions (GPTs), elevated
errors in ChatGPT conversations with files (Conversations). All resolved. No new service or component
names.

Community forum (Aug 9-10): background-mode requests stuck in progress via the Responses API; Codex
VS Code renderer crashing during concurrent agent streaming; Custom GPT image generation returning
file paths; GPT-5.6 Sol capacity issues in Codex Desktop; Codex rate-limit resets on paid plans;
phone verification for enterprise Codex accounts; Cloudflare/API compatibility; feature requests for
Codex on Linux. **No new model, endpoint or agent-feature announcements.**
**`gpt-realtime-2.1` / `-mini` did not appear at all this scan** and remain absent from SDK
changelogs and platform docs. WATCH CONTINUES (open since ~2026-07-06).

Updated: 2026-08-10 — no change.
